title: Pre-Removal Asbestos Sampling on Mold Remediation Jobs
content:
A Mold Remediation job in a building built before the asbestos sampling year cutoff carries a pre-removal asbestos sampling line. The samples are collected at the booking walkthrough, so the sampling line is dated the job's opened date and is booked once per job as one line of quantity 1 each whose rate is the line amount.

## Status and pricing basis for this line

- For the pre-removal asbestos sampling line, and only for that line, the job may be in scheduled, authorized, remediating, awaiting clearance or cleared status when it is charged; the work-plan visit line is governed by its own schedule, and every other scope line and every equipment day still requires the job to be in remediating, awaiting clearance or cleared status when it is charged.
- For the pre-removal asbestos sampling line, and only for that line, the amount is figured under the company's pricing for that sampling line; the work-plan visit line and the bagged debris haul-off line are priced under their own schedules, and every other scope line remains billed at the tier's unit rate for its code times the quantity performed, with labor the customer asks to have performed in the after-hours window billed at the hourly rate times the after-hours labor multiplier.

| Item on the job's records | How this line relates to it |
|---|---|
| Year built | The line belongs to jobs in buildings built before the asbestos sampling year cutoff |
| Opened date | The line's service date |
| Charge lines | One asbestos sampling line per job, quantity 1 each, rate equal to the amount |
| Status | Scheduled, authorized, remediating, awaiting clearance or cleared |

## Booking the line: `book_mold_presample_d4275783`

**Capability.** The tool records, on the named Mold Remediation job, one sampling charge line coded `asbestos_sampling` for the samples collected before any drywall, texture or insulation removal. The line is booked as quantity 1 each with the line amount as its rate, in the `business_hours` window, and the job's balance due rises by the amount. The new line is immediately visible among the job's charge lines.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent first unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `book_mold_presample_d4275783`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `mold_job_id` | The reference number of the mold remediation job the sampling is billed on, read from the job lookup for this customer | Reference number as shown on the job record |
| `service_date` | The date the samples were collected | Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, with no time or time zone; an empty value is not accepted |
| `amount` | The sampling charge in US dollars | A positive number with at most 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent half up; stored to the cent |

**Return.** On success, a confirmation naming the new charge line's reference number, the job reference number, the charge code `asbestos_sampling`, the service date (YYYY-MM-DD), the amount booked (USD, 2 decimals) and the job's new balance due (USD, 2 decimals). A reply starting with "Error:" means nothing was booked because an argument did not meet its stated format: a `service_date` that is not a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form, or an `amount` that is not a positive value with at most 2 decimal places.
